description: This file defines atomic operations and macros for use with C11 atomic types, specifically for jemalloc internal implementation.

methods.name: atomic_load_##short_type
methods.description: Loads the value of an atomic variable with specified memory order.

methods.name: atomic_store_##short_type
methods.description: Stores a value into an atomic variable with specified memory order.

methods.name: atomic_exchange_##short_type
methods.description: Atomically exchanges the value of an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_compare_exchange_weak_##short_type
methods.description: Performs a weak compare-and-exchange operation on an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_compare_exchange_strong_##short_type
methods.description: Performs a strong compare-and-exchange operation on an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_fetch_add_##short_type
methods.description: Atomically adds a value to an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_fetch_sub_##short_type
methods.description: Atomically subtracts a value from an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_fetch_and_##short_type
methods.description: Atomically performs bitwise AND on an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_fetch_or_##short_type
methods.description: Atomically performs bitwise OR on an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_fetch_xor_##short_type
methods.description: Atomically performs bitwise XOR on an atomic variable.
